Cam: spotted a burst of TLS resumption errors between apac->eu at ~09:12 UTC. Connection logs show a bunch of session-ticket validation failures and simultaneous KMS Deny entries. Anyone touching keystore/roles?

Nora: Pulling logs now. Key error snippet: `rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = KMS Decrypt failed for projects/.../cryptoKeys/mtls-session-key (principal=svc-session@prod)` — spikes line up with 09:10-09:14.

Ilya: I rolled out a tighter keystore binding this morning (PR 1402) to remove legacy group bindings. I tried to keep service accounts intact but may have missed the session SA.

Cam: That would explain it. Session-ticket flow fetches a wrapped seed from KMS to unwrap per-region session caches. If unwrap fails we fall back to generating a fresh ticket (higher CPU + latency) and sometimes reject resumptions.

security-oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) restore previous binding for mtls-session-key, 2) enable proxy fallback to ephemeral session seeds (`--session-seed-fallback=on`), 3) roll back PR. Which is fastest?

Ilya: I can add back the explicit binding for svc-session@prod and svc-resume@prod now. Will open PR and request expedited review.

SRE-Bot: deploy-bot: feature toggle applied to eu-proxy fleet: `--session-seed-fallback=on` (canary).

Cam: Canary shows resumptions stabilizing on the canary pod. Latency delta when falling back is ~+35ms. Good enough for now.

Ilya: PR 1409 opened to re-add principals. Will include an explicit test step.

security-oncall: follow-ups:
- add a CI check that validates IAM diffs against a maintained map of keystore consumers (session, proxy, ingest).
- add alerting: KMS decrypt denied (protoPayload.status.code=7) >10/min for any mtls key -> page eng-sre.
- instrument client to emit `keystore.unwrap.latency` and `keystore.unwrap.failures{principal,key,region}`.

Cam: audit query we used: `resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.status.code=7 AND protoPayload.request.name:mtls-session-key AND timestamp>"2026-08-11T09:05:00Z"` — saved as shared query "kms.session.unwrap.failures".

Nora: Note: when session tickets are regenerated we see increased token churn in east-west flows; add that to runbook (expected perf hit / mitigation steps).

Ilya: Merging PR after pair-review. Will coordinate canary verification with Cam. ETA 25m.

SRE-Bot: incident-bot: created ticket SEC-2026-202: "session-ticket-keystore-eviction-noise" and assigned to eng-security.

security-oncall: good blameless triage. Add retrospective: ensure runbook has region-mapping for keystore consumers and ensure any keystore RBAC change includes a smoke decrypt for each mapped principal.

Cam: Thanks. Will update ticket with timelines and perf graphs once PR verifies.

Ilya: sorry for the disruption, will add gating to infra PR template to avoid this class of error. :pray:
